scope: Live public struct and enum declaration fields. Trait/function adapters and whole module fingerprint remain pending.
decisions: Full namespace and containing struct path compose identity; enclosing struct path or empty string composes container.
Only public declarations contribute, but every struct field contributes irrespective of field visibility.
Member order is source order. Payload-free variants contribute an empty field. Type strings come from the qualified live TypeAnnotation adapter.
Generated key rules select domain and field-group order. Missing groups and duplicate bindings retain existing explicit KeyError failures.
Unsupported declaration categories are explicit errors; no trait/function omission is treated as a complete module interface.
